abstract: This paper explores the impact of government open data on corporate supply chain risk management. Based on data from Chinese A-share listed companies between 2008 and 2022, the study employs a staggered DID model and finds that the construction of government open data platforms can significantly reduce corporate supply chain risks. Specifically, a one-unit increase in government data openness is associated with an average 1.1% reduction in corporate supply chain risk. The research further reveals that government open data primarily lowers supply chain risk by reducing corporate debt financing costs, mitigating agency conflicts, and reducing information asymmetry. The effect is particularly pronounced in state-owned enterprises, firms with severe financing constraints, companies with small-scale commercial credit financing, and older enterprises.

abstract: Using model-free skewness measures that exploit the asymmetry in semivariances and option data from the over-the-counter currency market, we find that buying currencies with a high skewness risk premium (SRP) and selling currencies with a low SRP generates high returns and a Sharpe ratio. Asset pricing tests—which control for omitted variables and measurement errors—show that a SRP factor enters the currency pricing kernel and is central to the pricing of risks inherent in a broad currency cross section of 60 portfolio excess returns. These results imply that skewness risk is a strong and priced source of currency risk.
abstract_zh: 利用无模型偏度度量方法，该方法利用半方差的不对称性及场外货币市场期权数据，我们发现买入高偏度风险溢价（SRP）的货币并卖出低SRP的货币能产生高回报及夏普比率。资产定价测试——在控制遗漏变量和测量误差后——表明SRP因子进入货币定价核心，并对广泛货币截面中60个投资组合超额收益所固有的风险定价至关重要。这些结果意味着偏度风险是货币风险的一个强有力且被定价的来源。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Skewness Risk Premia and the Cross Section of Currency Returns
title_zh: 偏度风险溢价与货币收益的横截面

abstract: This study provides novel evidence on how Coasian bargaining can mitigate pollution spillovers. In this setting, water quality targets are negotiated to give upstream officials in regulated regions close to political borders more incentives to enforce tighter environmental regulations. Exploiting the first introduction of the ecological compensation initiative in the Xin’an River in 2011, we find that regulated firms have more than 56.95% lower chemical oxygen demand (COD) emission intensity but no lower output than unregulated firms in the same province. The salient gap in regulatory enforcement is driven by high-powered political incentives, in which water quality targets are internalized into government officials’ political promotion evaluations. However, differential regulatory enforcement tends to concentrate on water pollution from regulated to unregulated regions within the same jurisdiction, thereby exposing rivers, residents, and public health to higher levels of pollution.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于科斯式谈判如何缓解污染溢出效应的新证据。在该情境下，水质目标通过协商制定，旨在激励靠近政治边界的受监管地区的地方官员强化环境规制执行力度。基于2011年新安江流域首次实施生态补偿机制的准自然实验，研究发现：受监管企业的化学需氧量（COD）排放强度较同省未受监管企业下降超过56.95%，但产出水平并未降低。这种规制执行强度的显著差异源于高能政治激励——水质目标被纳入政府官员的政治晋升考核体系。然而，差异化的规制执行导致同一行政辖区内受监管地区的水污染向未受监管地区转移，进而使河流、居民及公共健康暴露于更高污染水平。

title: Coasian bargaining, political incentives, and pollution spillovers: evidence from China

abstract: We quantify the extent and drivers of payout smoothing by employing 34,966 US firms’ data from 1975 to 2022. We report that payout growth is almost insensitive to year-by-year net income growth, in line with preceding literature suggesting payout smoothing. Novel to the literature, we incorporate the dynamics of payout smoothing, permanent, and aggregate net income growth into the depiction. Though payout growth is mostly immune to annual income growth shocks, it is significantly affected by net income growth of 5- or 10-year periods. Firms also consider the aggregate-sectoral and/or country-level-income growth in payout decisions. Since both permanent and aggregate income growths take over the role of year-by-year income growth, we further investigate if firms’ financial positions impact the magnitude of the smoothing. Annual payout growth depends more on permanent income growth for firms with higher profits and lower leverage positions. Notably, more financially vulnerable firms with higher leverage adjust payouts more in line with aggregate economic conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1975年至2022年间34,966家美国企业的数据，量化了派息平滑的程度及其驱动因素。研究发现，派息增长对逐年净收入增长几乎不敏感，这与先前文献中关于派息平滑的结论一致。本文的创新之处在于，将派息平滑的动态特征、永久性净收入增长以及总体净收入增长纳入分析框架。尽管派息增长基本不受年度收入增长冲击的影响，但显著受5年或10年期净收入增长的影响。企业在制定派息决策时，还会考虑行业总体层面和/或国家层面的收入增长。由于永久性收入增长和总体收入增长共同取代了逐年收入增长的作用，我们进一步探究企业财务状况是否影响平滑程度。对于利润较高且杠杆率较低的企业，年度派息增长更依赖于永久性收入增长。值得注意的是，杠杆率较高、财务脆弱性更强的企业，其派息调整更贴合总体经济状况的变化。
